# Stellar TimeLock

> Non-custodial time-lock vault wallet for Android, built on Stellar/Soroban.

Stellar TimeLock lets users lock XLM and other Stellar assets in Soroban smart contracts until a chosen unlock time. Features include standard time-locks, cooling-off periods, vesting schedules, dead man's switch vaults, multi-sig, HTLC, multi-asset support, and optional swap.

This GitHub repository is a **public security and legal reference**. It does not contain the full Android app source or complete vault contract source (proprietary by design). It documents contract addresses, network endpoints, privacy/terms/disclosures, security modules/excerpts, and how to verify the app's non-custodial design.
